--account.help: Account ID to automatically map to its username

--all.help: Delete all matching mappings instead of just one

--all-regions.help: List clusters across all supported regions

--appmesh-preview-access.help: enable full access to AppMesh Preview

--attach-policy.help: Inline IAM policy document to attach to the role (JSON string)

--attach-policy-arn.help: ARN of the policies to attach

--attach-policy-arns.help: List of IAM policy ARNs to attach to the role

--attach-role-arn.help: ARN of the role to attach to the iamserviceaccount

--authenticator-role-arn.help: AWS IAM role to assume for authenticator

--auto-apply-pod-identity-associations.help: apply recommended pod identity associations for the addon(s), if supported

--cfn-role-arn.help: IAM role used by CloudFormation to call AWS API on your behalf

--chunk-size.help: return large lists in chunks rather than all at once, pass 0 to disable

--cluster-types.help: (optional) Specify the cluster type(s) to filter results. Valid options: eks, eks-local-outposts. Example: --cluster-types "eks"

--cluster-versions.help: (optional) Filter results by specific Kubernetes versions. Accepts multiple comma-separated values. Example: --cluster-versions "1.31,1.30"

--color.help: toggle colorized logs (valid options: true, false, fabulous)

--config-file.help: load configuration from a file (or stdin if set to '-')

--control-plane-subnet-ids.help: Subnet IDs for the control plane

--create-service-account.help: instructs eksctl to create the K8s service account

--default-only.help: (optional) When set, returns only the default version for the specified cluster type(s). Default: false

--disable-eviction.help: Force drain to use delete, even if eviction is supported. This will bypass checking PodDisruptionBudgets, use with caution.

--disable-nodegroup-eviction.help: Force drain to use delete, even if eviction is supported. This will bypass checking PodDisruptionBudgets, use with caution.

--disable-pod-imds.help: Blocks IMDS requests from non-host networking pods

--disable-session-tags.help: Disable session tags added by EKS Pod Identity (if not provided, session tags are enabled by default)

--drain.help: Drain and cordon all nodes in the nodegroup before deletion

--drain-parallel.help: Specifies the number of nodes to drain in parallel

--dumpLogs.help: dump logs to disk on failure if set to true

--enable-node-repair.help: Enable automatic node repair (managed nodegroups only)

--enable-zonal-shift.help: Enable zonal shift on a cluster

--exclude.help: iamserviceaccounts to exclude (list of globs), e.g.: 'default/s3-reader,*/dynamo-*'

--fargate.help: Create a Fargate profile scheduling pods in the default and kube-system namespaces onto Fargate

--force.help: Force migrates an existing self-managed add-on to an EKS managed add-on

--force-upgrade.help: Force the update if the existing node group's pods are unable to be drained due to a pod disruption budget issue

--group.help: Groups within Kubernetes to which IAM role is mapped

--include.help: iamserviceaccounts to include (list of globs), e.g.: 'default/s3-reader,*/dynamo-*'

--include-all.help: (optional) When set, includes unsupported versions in the results. Default: false

--kubernetes-username.help: A Kubernetes username to map to the principal ARN

--max-pods-per-node.help: maximum number of pods per node (set automatically if unspecified)

--namespace.help: Namespace in which to create RBAC resources (only valid with --service-name)

--namespace-config.help: Namespace configuration for addon deployment in the format 'namespace=<namespace-name>'

--no-disable-session-tags.help: Enable session tags added by EKS Pod Identity

--no-duplicate-arns.help: Throw error when an aws-auth record already exists with the given ARN

--node-drain-wait-period.help: Amount of time to wait between draining nodes in a nodegroup

--node-private-networking.help: whether to make nodegroup networking private

--node-security-groups.help: attach additional security groups to nodes

--nodegroup-parallelism.help: Number of self-managed or managed nodegroups to create in parallel

--nodes.help: total number of nodes (for a static ASG)

--only-missing.help: Only delete iamserviceaccounts that are not defined in the given config file

--output.help: specifies the output format (valid option: table, json, yaml)

--pod-eviction-wait-period.help: Duration to wait after failing to evict a pod

--policy.help: Optional policy that applies additional restrictions to this pod identity association beyond the IAM policies attached to the IAM role

--preserve.help: Delete the addon from the API but preserve its Kubernetes resources

--profile.help: AWS credentials profile to use (defaults to the value of the AWS_PROFILE environment variable)

--public-access-cidrs.help: CIDR blocks that EKS uses to create a security group on the public endpoint

--publishers.help: Addon publisher (optional, can be comma separated list e.g., --publishers "publisherA, publisherB"

--release-version.help: AMI version of the EKS optimized AMI to use

--remove-oidc-provider-trust-relationshi.help: Remove existing IRSAv1 OIDC provided entities

--resource-status.help: resource statuses to filter events by, e.g. `CREATE_FAILED`, `UPDATE_FAILED`

--role-arn.help: IAM role ARN for the capability (optional if IAM policies are provided)

--role-name.help: Set a custom name for the created role

--role-only.help: disable service account creation, only the role will be created

--set-kubeconfig-context.help: if true then current-context will be set in kubeconfig; if a context is already set then it will be overwritten

--skip-outdated-addons-check.help: whether the creation of ARM nodegroups should proceed when the cluster addons are outdated

--spot.help: Create a spot nodegroup (managed nodegroups only)

--ssh-public-key.help: SSH public key to use for nodes (import from local path, or use existing EC2 key pair)

--status.help: (optional) Filter results by support plan status. Valid options: EXTENDED_SUPPORT, STANDARD_SUPPORT

--subject-pattern.help: subject pattern to use in the trust policy (supports wildcards like '*' with StringLike condition)

--tags.help: Tags to apply to the capability

--target-role-arn.help: ARN of the target IAM role for cross-account access (default to empty string for no cross-account access)

--timeout.help: maximum waiting time for any long-running operation

--trail.help: lookup CloudTrail events for the cluster

--types.help: Addon type (optional, can be comma separated list e.g., --types "typeA, typeB"

--vpc-cidr.help: global CIDR to use for VPC
